title: Final velocity expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct final algebraic expression for the velocity at plate B, v = 3 * sqrt(2 * U0 * q / (7 * m)).

title: Final plate distance expression
description: Essential: The response must provide the correct final algebraic expression for the plate separation, d = sqrt(7 * U0 * q * T0^2 / (2 * m)).

title: Two-stage acceleration analysis
description: Important: The solution must correctly derive the different accelerations (a1, a2) from the changing voltage, using E=U/d and F=ma.

title: Kinematics in first phase
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics (v1 = a1*T0, x1 = 1/2*a1*T0^2) for the constant-acceleration phase from 0 to T0.

title: Kinematics in second phase
description: Important: The solution must correctly apply kinematics (x2 = v1*T0 + 1/2*a2*T0^2, v = v1 + a2*T0) for the constant-acceleration phase from T0 to 2T0.

title: Total displacement condition
description: Important: The solution must state or use the condition that the sum of displacements (x1 + x2) equals the plate separation d.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the solution incorrectly handles the sign/direction of acceleration, velocity, or electric field when the voltage polarity changes.

title: Unit consistency check
description: Optional: Award credit if the student explicitly checks or comments on the dimensional consistency of their final expressions.
